ordered_steps: Resolve source and iconography constraints before prompt construction.
Select only the relevant reference assets and assign an explicit A, B, C or D role.
State only the participating characters and event-correct manifestations.
Describe shot scale, staging, environment and narrative focus.
State essential Indian cultural conventions and current-story evidence status.
State critical exclusions, including forbidden content transfer.
Supply exact reference images when the provider supports it.
Keep source provenance, hashes and broader evidence in structured metadata rather than dumping it into the visual prompt.
conciseness_rule: Do not include the complete source graph, entire character bible or complete rules document. Bind those hashes in metadata and include only resolved constraints relevant to this scene.
artwork_rule: Generate clean artwork without permanent captions, dialogue, page numbers or watermarks unless a separately approved lettering experiment explicitly says otherwise.
failure_rule: When one still would require mutually sequential or contradictory actions, return to the storyboard and use separate panels; never rewrite the source to fit a model limitation.
